title: Personal Credit Cards: how many cards one customer may hold
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: limits on holding more than one card

This policy covers applications for the Personal Credit Cards line of Piedmont Crescent Bank. It governs whether a new card application may be recorded for a customer who already holds, or once held, one or more PCB credit cards.

## Policy clauses

1. A customer may hold more than one PCB credit card, but never two of the same tier.
2. Before a new application is recorded, the count of the customer's card accounts in applied, active or suspended status must be below 3.
3. The customer may not hold another card of the requested tier in applied, active or suspended status.
4. A customer with any card account in charged-off status cannot open a new card.
5. Closed accounts do not count.

## Basis of each check

| Check | What is examined | Authority |
|---|---|---|
| Portfolio count | the customer's card accounts in applied, active or suspended status, counted across the customer | the bank's account records before the application is recorded |
| One card per tier | whether the customer already has a card of the requested tier in applied, active or suspended status | the bank's account records, matched on the customer and the requested tier |
| No charged-off card | whether any of the customer's card accounts is in charged-off status | the bank's account records for that customer |

Each check reads the bank's own account records at the time the application would be recorded; what the customer says about their cards does not replace those records.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical customers)

- A customer with an active card and a suspended card has a count of 2, which is below 3, so the portfolio count does not bar a new application.
- A customer with one applied, one active and one suspended card has a count of 3, which is not below 3, so a new application may not be recorded.
- A customer whose earlier card of the requested tier is closed does not hold that tier for this check, because closed accounts do not count.
- A customer with a single card, in charged-off status, cannot open a new card even though the count of applied, active or suspended cards is 0.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Does a charged-off card count toward the limit of 3?**
A: The count covers only applied, active and suspended accounts. A charged-off account is examined separately: any charged-off card bars a new card on its own.

**Q: May a customer hold two cards of different tiers?**
A: This policy allows more than one card, subject to the checks above; what it never allows is two cards of the same tier in applied, active or suspended status.
